generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noConnection: No connection — check your network and try again.
noServerResponse: Server didn't respond — please try again in a moment.
TOO_MANY_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed login attempts. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again.
PASSWORD_POLICY: Password must be 8 to 72 characters and include 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 digit, and 1 symbol.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You must change your password before continuing.
NEW_PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: New password must be different from your current password.
NOZZLE_SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} already has an open shift (ID {{shiftId}}).
OPERATOR_INACTIVE: {{operatorName}} is inactive and cannot be assigned a shift.
CLOSING_READING_BELOW_OPENING: Closing reading {{closingReading}} is below the opening reading {{openingReading}} for the {{fuelTypeCode}} nozzle. Please verify the meter reading.
CREDIT_ENTRIES_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Sum of all credit entries (₹{{entriesTotal}}, of which ₹{{alreadyRecorded}} was already recorded during the shift) does not match the credit total (₹{{creditTotal}}). A credit entry may have been added while you were closing — reload the shift and check the entries.
CREDIT_CLIENT_DISABLED: Credit is disabled for '{{clientName}}'. Enable the client on the Credit page before giving it credit.
CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Credit limit exceeded for '{{clientName}}'. Outstanding (group): {{outstanding}}, this entry: {{amount}}, limit: {{limit}}.
CREDIT_BILLING_CYCLE_OVERDUE: Credit sales blocked for '{{clientName}}': billing cycle overdue. The client must settle their outstanding balance or an Admin/Owner must grant a Credit Extension.
INSUFFICIENT_FUEL_STOCK: Insufficient fuel stock: shift recorded {{litresSold}} L sold but only {{litresAvailable}} L is available in inventory. Please verify the meter readings or record a tanker delivery first.
